title: More than 200 Partners Have Joined in Advance, Qwen Open Platform Accelerates the Practical Application of AI Intelligent Agents
excerpt: Within 4 days of its launch, the Qwen Open Platform has received more than 200 applications from ecosystem partners. The platform was officially launched on Aug
content_html:
Within 4 days of its launch, the Qwen Open Platform has received more than 200 applications from ecosystem partners. The platform was officially launched on August 10, offering AI agent creation and access capabilities to ecosystem partners and developers, enabling them to integrate their agent services into the Qwen APP, providing services in over ten fields such as logistics transportation, real estate living, local lifestyle, finance, and automotive.

Currently, the platform has attracted third-party partners such as SF Express, Swan to Home, KE Holdings, and Lenovo, as well as Alibaba ecosystem products like Cainiao and Quark Cloud Drive, covering multiple high-frequency life and consumption scenarios.

Regarding infrastructure, the Qwen Open Platform provides partners with account management, AI payment, order integration, and other capabilities, along with built-in front-end components and development templates to lower the barriers for agent development and integration. Partners can complete agent migration and go live without making large-scale modifications to their existing services, using one-click authorization and end-to-end debugging methods.

Based on the initial speed of onboarding, Qwen is accelerating the construction of an open ecosystem centered around AI agents. By connecting third-party services with its own application scenarios, it is driving AI Agents to evolve from single tools into direct service access points.

content_html_zh:
Qwen开放平台上线4天内，已收到生态合作伙伴超过200个申请。 该平台于8月10日正式上线，为生态合作伙伴和开发者提供AI代理创建和接入能力，使其能够将代理服务集成到Qwen APP中，提供物流运输、房地产居住、本地生活、金融、汽车等十多个领域的服务。

目前，该平台已吸引顺丰速运、天鹅到家、可可控股、联想等第三方合作伙伴，以及菜鸟、夸克云盘等阿里生态产品，覆盖多个高频生活消费场景。

在基础设施方面，Qwen开放平台为合作伙伴提供账户管理、AI支付、订单集成等能力，并内置前端组件和开发模板，降低代理商开发和集成的门槛。 合作伙伴无需对现有服务进行大规模修改，通过一键授权和端到端调试的方式即可完成代理迁移并上线。

在初期上线速度的基础上，Qwen正在加速构建以AI代理为核心的开放生态系统。 通过连接第三方服务和自身应用场景，正在推动AI Agent从单一工具演变成直接的服务接入点。
